name: Ahmad Nameh
bio: Ahmad co-founded Alphabyte and leads the firm's business intelligence and digital advisory practice. He partners with executive teams at mid-market companies across many industries, guiding them through the strategic choices that turn data, reporting, and operations into competitive advantage rather than overhead.

His engagements focus on the leadership questions that sit above tooling: where the business is trying to go, which capabilities matter most, what to invest in now versus later, and how to sequence the work so it compounds. He brings a senior advisor's judgment to clients navigating modernisation, growth, and operational complexity.
